races.paceDynamic: D Flawless, Miss Rainbow, and Sherlock will ensure a strong gallop from the start, creating a genuine test of stamina over this 6f trip. With six hold-up horses needing to come from behind, the early pace battle between the three confirmed leaders will likely set up a tactical finish where positioning and timing become crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runners collapse late
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast early and crack in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The strong early pace takes its toll on D Flawless, Miss Rainbow and Sherlock. Kings Merchant and Pianoforte, the highest-rated closers, storm home late to contest the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained gallop throughout
scenarios.trigger: If D Flawless or Sherlock can dictate at a controlled tempo
scenarios.body: One of the leaders manages the pace intelligently and has enough left to hold off the closers. The hold-up horses struggle to make up ground against the sustained gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy early pace
scenarios.trigger: If the three front runners interfere with each other or go in snatches
scenarios.body: The pace becomes uneven with the leaders getting in each other's way early on. This suits the patient hold-up horses who can pick their moment to strike in the straight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint finish develops
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Rainbow drops back early leaving just two leaders
scenarios.body: With reduced early pace pressure, the race becomes more tactical and turns into a sprint. The fresher horses with tactical speed can quicken best in the final two furlongs.

races.paceDynamic: Five confirmed front runners (Power Fizz, Sergeant Wilko, Twilight Fun, Mister Bluebird, Hockney) will create a fierce early gallop in this 14-runner handicap. The pace will be searching from the off, with multiple leaders disputing through the opening furlongs before stamina becomes crucial. This strong gallop will set up the race perfectly for the hold-up horses like Badri, Andesite and Rousing Encore to sweep through late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the five front runners go too fast and crack before halfway
scenarios.body: The leaders will tie up dramatically in the final furlong as the pace takes its toll. Hold-up horses with the highest ratings will have first run on the faltering leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Power Fizz or Sergeant Wilko can sustain the gallop without cracking
scenarios.body: One of the pace-setters will prove tough enough to withstand the pressure and see off late challengers. The strong early pace will still bring stamina into play but won't completely exhaust the leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swamp Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong enough to set up a cavalry charge but leaders don't collapse completely
scenarios.body: Multiple hold-up horses will unleash coordinated late runs as the pace begins to tell in the final two furlongs. The highest-rated closers will have enough time to reel in tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses can avoid the early pace battle while staying close enough
scenarios.body: Horses tracking the leaders like Wicket Keeper and Venture Capital will strike at the perfect moment between pace collapse and late surge. They'll have the ideal position to capitalize when leaders tire but before hold-up horses arrive.

How quickly Wicket Keeper and Venture Capital can secure prominent positions without getting trapped.
